headline: OceanPact Sells Two Vessels for USD 86 Million to Accelerate Deleveraging
summary: OceanPact agreed to sell two vessels for USD 86 million, generating a relevant gain, accelerating deleveraging, and reinforcing expectations for extraordinary dividends.
why: Asset sales by marine service providers impact corporate balance sheet health and debt reduction schedules, influencing analyst valuations and shareholder returns.

impacts.name: OceanPact
impacts.why: The multi-million dollar vessel sale improves cash flow and debt metrics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The significant cash infusion from asset sales directly reduces corporate debt and supports dividend payout expectations.
